---

### Public surface

**Frame (sole I/O currency)**
- `cpu::Frame` — public physical surface is exactly `blocks` + `meta` + `box`; typed spans via `ColKey` / `MetaKey` (`kAtom_x`, `kEnergy`, …); no parallel `*System` / public `AtomList`
- `cpu::Box` — cell + min-image cache; `Box::cubic`
- `cpu::materialize` / `write_back` — molrs.Frame ⇄ cpu::Frame (schema v2, once per `run`)
- `cuda::Frame` / `cuda::Box` — device pointers + host counts; `cpu::to_cuda` / `cuda::to_cpu`
- Frame purity: method scratch (integrals, AO maps, DIIS, pair list) is **not** on Frame; neighbor list lives on `NeighborList` → non-owning `ctx.md.pair_list`

**Driver / registration**
- Core: `ATV::Driver<PhaseEnum, DeviceTag>` + `Plan` / `Stage` / `slot_of` / `make_binding`
- CPU loop node: `cpu::Driver<PhaseEnum>` → presets
- **Plan primitive (public):** only `on(phase).add(...)` / `add_ref(...)` (and nested-driver overloads). **No public `Driver::add` that guesses phase.**
- **Protected:** `bind_defaults` / `bind_defaults_ref` (used by categorical setters + criteria with stage bindings)
- **Categorical (on `cpu::Driver`, plural where noted):**
  - `set_evaluator` / `set_evaluator_ref` — **plural** energy/force sources at `eval_phase` order 0 (pair, bonded, QMMM, GPW, HF methods, AIMD wrappers, bias, …); identity is **type**, not setter name
  - `set_neighbor` / `_ref` — singular
  - `set_observer` / `set_record` / `_ref` — plural
  - `set_thermo(every)` — singular
  - `add_criterion` / `add_criterion_ref` — plural; severity Stop > Converged > Continue
  - `set_outcome` — singular (MC accept/reject)
- MD-only: `set_integrator` (singular), `set_thermostat` / `set_barostat` (plural), `set_nvt`, `set_scalar_reduce_every`, DD adopt/release
- Minimize-only: `set_optimizer`
- MC-only: `set_mover`
- Ownership rule: rvalue owns; lvalue requires `*_ref`; plain lvalue owning overloads deleted

**Presets (Driver = staged loop + Criterion; no category bases)**

| Preset | Phase | Default termination |
|--------|-------|---------------------|
| `cpu::Evaluate` / `cuda::Evaluate` | `evaluate::Phase` | one pass |
| `cpu::md::MD` / `cuda::md::MD` | `md::Phase` | step budget |
| `cpu::minimizer::Minimize` / `cuda::…` | `minimizer::Phase` | `ForceConverged` |
| `cpu::vib::Hessian` | `vib::Phase` | fixed 6N + finalize (**CPU**) |
| `cpu::mc::MC` / `NptMc` / `Gcmc` | `sampling::Phase` | budget + `Metropolis` family outcome (**CPU**) |
| `cpu::PathDriver` | `path::Phase` | `AllReplicasConverged` (**CPU**) |
| SCF loop shape | `scf::Phase` | residual criteria (hosted by concrete methods) |

Also: `cpu::SubDriver` nesting on shared `Runtime`; criteria `ForceConverged`, `AllReplicasConverged`, `StopOnNaN`.

**Component kinds / protocols (CPU)**
- Kinds: `Potential`, `HF`, `Semiempirical`, `PlaneWave`, `GPW`, `Bias`, `PathCoupling`, `Observer`, `Recorder`, `Integrator`, `Thermostat`, `Barostat`, `Optimizer`, `Constraint`, `Mover`, `Criterion`
- Protocols: `HaloParticipant`, `NeighborConsumer`/`NeighborProvider`, `LongRangeParticipant`, `PairPotential`/`PairEvaluator`, `TimestepProvider`/`TimestepConsumer`, `ConstraintProvider`, `AsyncComponent`
- Context slices: `md` / `mc` / `opt` / `path` / `loop` / `exec` / `analysis`

**Concrete electronic methods (target API; parameters = members / ctor args)**
- Gaussian: `cpu::scf::RHF`, `ROHF`, `UHF`, `GHF`, `RKS`, `UKS`, `ROKS` via `methods.h` / `MeanFieldMethod`; umbrella alias `cpu::scf::SCF = RKS` (compat)
- Post-HF / response (CPU scf/): MP2–MP4, CCSD, EOM-*, CASSCF/CASCI/FCI/NEVPT2, TDHF, BSE, ADC, G0W0, RPA, Wannier, DFT-D3/D4, …
- GPW: `cpu::gpw::Kind`, `GthPotential`, `GaussianBasis`, `GPWEvaluator` / `GpwDft`; post: MP2, RPA, G0W0, Wannier
- Plane-wave: `cpu::pw::PW`, `PWResult`, `PWEvaluator` (`with_gradient` / `with_stress`)
- Semiempirical: `AM1` + `AM1Evaluator`, `RM1*`, `DFTB2`, `XtbGfn0`, AM1-BCC assigner
- Single-point helper: `cpu::single_point(frame, method)`

**AIMD (`cpu/electronic/`) — strategies are types, not public flags**
- Propagators (infra, method-agnostic dense algebra): `Cpmd` / `CpmdCplx`, `XlBomd` / `XlBomdCplx`, `ASPCPredictor` / `ASPCPredictorCplx`
- **Force-slot wrappers (register via `set_evaluator`):**
  - `electronic::CarParrinello` — owns pure `GPWEvaluator` + μ; optional `ElectronicThermostat`; no public `method.cpmd = true`
  - `electronic::XlBomdForce` — XL-BOMD on GPW; optional `XlBomdLinearized` tag
  - `electronic::SecondGenCp` — ASPC + partial SCF on GPW
  - `electronic::CarParrinelloMethod<M>` / `XlBomdMethod<M>` — wrap concrete mean-field `RHF`/`RKS`/… (sets protected base flags in ctor only)

**QMMM (`cpu/multiscale/`)**
- `LinkBond`, `place_link_hydrogen`, `project_link_force`
- `QmmmMechanical` — DFTB2 QM + LJ MM (Potential)
- `QmmmElectrostatic` — RHF + MM point charges + LJ + optional link H
- `QmmmPolarizable` — RHF + Thole induced dipoles + LJ; free `solve_induced_dipoles`

**Classical MD / FF (sample)**
- Integrators: `VelocityVerlet`, `NoseHooverNPT`, `NphIntegrator`, Brownian, …
- Thermostats/barostats: `NoseHoover`, `FixLangevin`, `FixCSVR`, Berendsen, PR NPT, surface-tension NPT, …
- Pairs: `PairLJCut`, `PairLJCutCoulLong`, Morse, Buckingham, Born, Yukawa, DPD, WCA, SW, EAM (`EAMPotential` lookup ctor), Gaussian coulomb, PIM dipoles, …
- Bonded: `BondHarmonic`/`FENE`, `AngleHarmonic`, `DihedralMultiHarmonic`/`Charmm`, impropers
- Neighbor: `cpu::md::NeighborList<>`, `cuda::NeighborList` (OpenMM clusters)
- Long-range: `CoulLong` + `Ewald`/`PME`/`PPPM`/`KSpace` (matched LongRangeParticipant pair)
- Electrodes / const-potential: `const_potential*`, `ChargeASPC`, `piston_electrode`, `dipole_electrode_joint`, QEq, …

**Path / replica (CPU)**
- `PathDriver`, `NebCoupling`, `BandLBFGS`, `RingPolymerSpring`
- Method objects: `Remd`, `HRemd`, `Pimd`, `Dimer`, `Irc`, `StringMethod`
- `ReplicaSet`, `LinearInterpolation`, `IdentityReplication`

**Bias (CPU):** `DistanceCV` / `AngleCV` / `DihedralCV`, `HarmonicBias`, `Metadynamics` / `Metadynamics1D`

**Observe / record / IO (CPU primary):** RDF (+ molrs accumulator), VirialStress, Mulliken/Löwdin/ESP, MSD/VACF, Widom/WHAM, electrode/capacitance observers; `Thermo`, `XYZ`, cube writers; `extxyz`, `lammps_data`, `forcefield`, `frame_writer`

**CUDA classical MD rule (binding):** OpenMM cluster/tile engine only (spatial reorder → clusters **32** → AABB → CSR + real masks → tile SM force). Forbidden: `NonbondedStyle` / dual Verlet force architecture; scrubbed by `cuda_openmm_md_scrub.sh`.

**Iron laws on public surface**
- No public `make_*` / `build_*` / `*_config()` factories (`no_factory_scrub.sh`)
- No public `*Config` bags — ctor args + members; private internal OK under `internal/`
- Units on public surface: eV, Å, fs, amu, eV/Å, K (SCF/PW internal Ha/Ry → eV on Frame)

---

### Style summary

- **Naming:** full English directory names, mirrored CPU/CUDA; namespaces lag dirs (`cpu::md::MD` under `dynamics/`). Extensions: CPU `.h/.cpp`, CUDA `.cuh/.cu`, core `.h`. Public symbols under `ATV::` / `ATV::cpu` / `ATV::cuda`.
- **Construction:** OOP default — domain concepts are types with methods; construct → configure members → `build`/`run`/`launch`. Lookup tables as ctors (`GthPotential(Element, name)`). No factories; no public Config bags.
- **Driver model:** staged typed phase enum + iteration + Criterion termination (+ optional OutcomePolicy). Presets only add defaults in constructors. Algorithms publish metrics; criteria judge; loop owns `IterationStatus`.
- **Registration:** `on(phase).add` is the only Plan primitive; `set_evaluator` is the shared categorical energy/force entry (plural). AIMD via typed wrappers, not public boolean switches on evaluators.
- **Frame purity / backend isolation:** backend-specific types (xtensor, CUDA runtime) must not leak into core/facade or across backends. Pair/reciprocal math is backend-owned (no top-level shared math module).
- **Units & precision:** eV/Å/fs; `StorageReal`/`WorkReal`/`AccReal` (+ CUDA `real_t`/`work_t`/`prec_t`); integer roles `LocalInt`/`TagInt`/`ImageInt`/`BigInt`.
- **Errors:** lookup tables throw on unsupported input (no silent fallbacks); ownership misuse deleted at compile time.
- **Tests:** unit only under `tests/`; e2e in `regressions/`; architecture scrubs enforce layout, factories, OpenMM path, stage typing, SCF phase bans.

---

### Layer roles

| Module path | Role |
|-------------|------|
| `core/` | **Core contracts** — device tags, precision, units, Frame schema keys, Driver template, Plan/Stage, Role, Verdict, iteration status, molrs contract |
| `molrs.hpp` | **IO / FFI contract** boundary to Rust molrs |
| `*/frame/` | **Frame pillar** — device-resident state + box + materialize/transfer |
| `*/driver/` | **Driver pillar** — loop node, Runtime coordinator, criteria, outcome, nested drivers |
| `*/component/` | **Component pillar** — base, kinds, protocols, Context service slices |
| `*/device/` | **Shared infra** — threads/streams/timing |
| `*/communication/` | **Shared infra** — domain decomposition, halo, migration, reductions |
| `*/neighbor/` | **Shared infra** — pair lists (CUDA: OpenMM cluster engine) |
| `*/asynchronous/` | **Shared infra** — async analysis / D2H bridges |
| `cpu/linalg/`, `cpu/electronic/` (propagators) | **Shared infra** — dense LA + electronic DOF propagators |
| `cpu/electronic/` (CarParrinello, XlBomdForce, SecondGenCp, *Method) | **Domain** — AIMD force-slot components wrapping methods |
| `*/evaluate/` | **Domain** — single-point Evaluate preset |
| `*/dynamics/` | **Domain** — classical MD |
| `cpu/montecarlo/` | **Domain** — MC sampling |
| `*/minimize/` | **Domain** — geometry / cell optimization |
| `cpu/replica/`, `cpu/path/` | **Infra + domain** — replica expansion infra; coupled-replica methods |
| `cpu/scf/`, `cuda/scf/` | **Domain** — Gaussian electronic structure (CUDA subset / debt) |
| `cpu/semiempirical/` | **Domain** — NDDO/DFTB/xTB |
| `*/planewave/`, `cpu/gpw/`, `cpu/xc/` | **Domain** — PW / GPW / shared XC |
| `*/longrange/`, `*/potentials/` | **Domain** — reciprocal + real-space FF |
| `cpu/bias/`, `cpu/multiscale/`, `cpu/electrodes/` | **Domain** — enhanced sampling, QMMM, electrode models |
| `*/observe/`, `*/record/` | **Domain** — derived quantities + I/O sinks |
| `cpu/io/` | **IO** — external formats / molrs writers |
| `cpu/vibration/` | **Domain** — Hessian / phonon / thermochemistry |
| `cpu/task/` | **Infra / app bridge** — launcher task materialization |
| `torch/*` | **Backend kernel (experimental)** — autograd Frame + thin potentials |

**Pillar summary:** three pillars (Driver / Component / Frame) × three backends (cpu / cuda / torch) behind CUDA-free `core/`; domain dirs are orthogonal and name-mirrored; backend roots hold **directories only**, never loose shared files.

### Architecture scrubs (ctest)

**`tests/architecture/`**
- factory ban, OpenMM CUDA MD path, layout mirror, backend scrub, no top-level shared math, driver names, path words, SCF/post-HF dedup, no AO2MO public, docs vocab, …

**`tests/core/`**
- stage typing (`slot_of` only), no facade residual

**`tests/cpu/` + `tests/cuda/`**
- Frame hard-cut / field-list / compatibility surface; CUDA RDF molrs-only
